title: a11y focus tier chain: implementation detail (howto)
desc: T2 howto for a11y-focus-tier-chain. Overlay guard, source files, focusless-first principle detail, and full common-pitfalls examples for the SmartSetWindowOrder / focus-tier chain.
steps: SuppressFullscreenOpaqueOverlays [A11yCommand.WindowActions.cs]: pre-check on every a11y command. Samples 5 pixels (center + 4 quadrant centers) on every visible window >= 80% work area. avg brightness < 80/765 -> force alpha=0 (WS_EX_LAYERED) OR SW_MINIMIZE (non-layered). Same HWND suppressed >= 4 times -> kill the process. Logs [OVERLAY-GUARD] to stderr. Handles NVIDIA GeForce Overlay, TextInputHost, and any unknown black fullscreen overlays. SOURCE FILES: A11yCommand.WindowActions.cs (SmartSetWindowOrder, PlaceRootBehindForeground, A11yFocus, SuppressFullscreenOpaqueOverlays), A11yActions.Focus.cs (A11yFocusElement, FindRootWindow, TryCdpFocus), A11yCommand.cs:1907 (write action pre-focus injection, 10 actions)

FOCUSLESS-FIRST PRINCIPLE: UIA Invoke/SetValue/Toggle/Select/Scroll are inherently focusless -- no window activation needed. SendInput and WM_CHAR (some) require keyboard focus. SmartSetWindowOrder (Z-order) is separate from keyboard focus -- correct Z-order (rank 2) is possible without keyboard focus. The focus tier chain (Tier 0-3) sets keyboard focus on the element; SmartSetWindowOrder ensures the window is visible. Both are focusless from the USER perspective -- the user active window (rank 1) is never disrupted

COMMON PITFALLS (full): DO NOT use SetForegroundWindow -- steals keyboard focus, triggers WM_ACTIVATE, disrupts user. DO NOT use BringWindowToTop on root windows -- use PlaceRootBehindForeground instead. DO NOT skip topmost strip -- if WS_EX_TOPMOST is set, rank-2 placement has no effect. DO NOT assume GetParent equals owner -- popup/dialog owners use GW_OWNER (GetWindow), not GetParent. DO NOT skip iconic check inside SmartSetWindowOrder -- child BringWindowToTop on a minimized parent creates a ghost MDI entry with no visible surface. DO always pass SWP_NOACTIVATE with SetWindowPos Z-order changes. DO call SmartSetWindowOrder before element focus tiers (Tier -1 in A11yFocusElement).
